scope: Browser tests using a mocked Tauri bridge. NOT Windows capture tests.

results.name: Browser-only preview displays warning and refuses recording
Native-bridge source list is bound to the selector
Region mode prevents recording until a crop is selected
Start forwards real option shape and prevents duplicate commands
Pause and resume reflect backend states rather than local timers
Close protection event is visibly presented
Stop returns to idle after the mocked processing response
Screenshot button invokes native command, not browser getDisplayMedia
Capture errors are surfaced and do not show fake success
Library titles are escaped as text and literal search filters results
No unhandled browser exceptions in the normal interaction flow
Missing FFmpeg disables audio and pause but permits silent single-segment recording
Region overlay converts CSS drag bounds to physical pixels
